📢Following the recent announcement, we are officially launching our 𝐃𝐨𝐧𝐚𝐭𝐢𝐨𝐧 𝐃𝐫𝐢𝐯𝐞 𝐟𝐨𝐫 𝐭𝐡𝐞 𝐖𝐢𝐥𝐥𝐢𝐚𝐦𝐄𝐬𝐭 𝐅𝐢𝐫𝐬𝐭 𝐅𝐚𝐧 𝐌𝐞𝐞𝐭𝐢𝐧𝐠 𝐢𝐧 𝐌𝐚𝐧𝐢𝐥𝐚 (𝐌𝐚𝐫𝐜𝐡 𝟐𝟐, 𝟐𝟎𝟐𝟔)💙❤️✨

This project is dedicated to creating a memorable, meaningful experience for William and Est, made possible by the collective love of Westies. Any amount, no matter how small or big, will be sincerely appreciated. 🙏

This collective fan project entitled ❣️𝐖𝐄 𝐚𝐫𝐞 𝐋𝐨𝐯𝐞𝐬𝐭𝐫𝐮𝐜𝐤 𝐢𝐧 𝐌𝐍𝐋❣️is a partnership among the following fanbases (@WilliamEstPH, @phwilliamjkp, @FilosFor_Est) and fan support individuals and group (@FiloWesties, @luvfairyfairies, @MV112000).  

Let’s make this event extra special together, Filipino Westies! 🎸🦈 Bayanihan for WilliamEst!
